entries.proposition: Older sister: four antiseizure drugs failed.
entries.snippet: A trial of antiepileptic medications including phenobarbitone, clonazepam, phenytoin and levetiracetam, all failed to control the seizures.

entries.proposition: Younger sister: phenobarbitone, clobazam and topiramate gave a partial response.
entries.snippet: Antiepileptic medications including phenobarbitone, clobazam and topiramate showed partial response.

entries.proposition: Older sister was 7 years old at report.
Older sister became ventilator-dependent through a tracheostomy.
entries.snippet: At 2 years of age, she had progressive respiratory insufficiency requiring CPAP through tracheostomy, which eventually needed to be changed to mechanical ventilation.

entries.proposition: Older sister is in a vegetative state with intractable seizures at report.
entries.snippet: Currently, she is severely impaired with intractable seizure and in a vegetative state.

entries.proposition: Loss of function is predicted, not measured.
entries.snippet: The W44X pathogenic mutation in the WWOX gene is predicted to cause loss of normal protein function either through protein truncation or nonsense-mediated mRNA decay.

entries.proposition: Follow-up MRI showed restricted diffusion along the brainstem corticospinal tract.
entries.snippet: There is focal restricted diffusion along the cortico-spinal tract in the brain stem
